item.title: NIO CEO: Smart EVs Are Largest Embodied Agents
item.description:
NIO CEO William Li stated at the World Internet Conference that smart electric vehicles are currently the most shipped embodied agents and the largest AI application industry. Citing MIIT data showing over 60 million cars with assisted driving features, he revealed NIO's world model-based system is deployed on 950,000 vehicles. This perspective aims to redefine autonomous driving within the context of embodied intelligence.

原文标题：李斌称智能汽车是最大具身智能体

Why it matters：将自动驾驶纳入具身智能叙事框架，提供了行业规模化的新视角，但缺乏底层技术突破细节。

item.title: Chinese Firms Order 6M Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 Cards Amid Supply Crunch
item.description:
Major Chinese tech firms including Alibaba, Tencent, and ByteDance have ordered approximately 6 million Nvidia RTX Pro 5500 GPUs worth $70 billion, yet Nvidia can supply only about 1% within the next four months. Demand is driven by the card's compliance with US export limits and its 84GB GDDR7 memory, which enables single-card inference for 70B-parameter models. However, global production is capped at an estimated 3 million units in 2027 as TSMC capacity shifts to Rubin chips, creating a severe supply-demand gap.

原文标题：中国云厂商订购 600 万张 RTX Pro 5500 显卡 供需缺口巨大

Why it matters：揭示了地缘政治背景下高端 AI 算力硬件的极端供需失衡及具体技术规格对采购决策的影响。

item.title: GlobalFoundries Q3 Revenue Up 13% Despite $270M Net Loss
item.description:
GlobalFoundries reported a 13% year-over-year revenue increase to $1.899 billion in its fiscal Q3 2026, with record-high gross margins driven by data center and AI-related businesses. However, the company posted a net loss of $270 million due to one-time non-cash share issuance costs.

原文标题：格罗方德 Q3 营收增 13% 但净亏 2.7 亿美元

Why it matters：虽涉及算力芯片代工巨头，但核心为常规财务披露且亏损源于会计调整，对技术演进或市场格局影响有限。

item.title: Google Struggles to Monetize AI as Search Revenue Growth Slows
item.description:
Alphabet's earnings reveal that despite search queries hitting a five-year high, revenue growth slowed to 12% YoY due to rising AI infrastructure costs and decelerating paid clicks. Investors are questioning Google's ability to monetize AI effectively compared to its legacy search engine, triggering a ~14% drop in share price.

原文标题：谷歌 AI 变现遇阻 搜索营收增速放缓致股价跌

item.description:
Huawei Cloud's AgentArts became the first platform to pass CAICT's enterprise agent evaluation with the highest rating (Level 4+). The platform emphasizes production-grade long-horizon tasks, security, and observability, supporting both managed agents and custom code deployment.

item.title: Altman Clarifies Memory Remarks: Claims Out-of-Context, Urges Capacity Expansion
item.description:
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman addressed backlash over his comments suggesting personal PC memory is inefficiently allocated, clarifying that he advocates for global DRAM capacity expansion to support AI infrastructure rather than restricting user ownership. Despite the clarification, the AI-driven memory shortage—dubbed the 'RAMpocalypse'—has already triggered price hikes in consumer hardware, fueling ongoing debates about resource allocation fairness.

原文标题：奥尔特曼回应内存言论争议：称遭断章取义，呼吁扩大产能

Why it matters：事件反映了 AI 基础设施扩张与消费电子供应链之间的深层矛盾，虽属舆论回应，但对理解当前算力资源紧张局势具有参考价值。

item.title: Synaptics Legal Threats Halt Open-Source DisplayLink Driver
item.description:
Synaptics issued cease-and-desist notices to developers of the 'Vino' open-source DisplayLink driver, forcing its removal. This action blocks community support for modern USB graphics hardware on Linux, highlighting tensions between patent enforcement and open-source development.

原文标题：Synaptics 发律师函下架开源 DisplayLink 驱动

Why it matters：事件揭示了大厂利用法律手段压制社区逆向工程驱动的典型案例，对 Linux 硬件支持生态有警示意义。

item.title: CXMT Proposes Raising Share Buyback Cap to 5 Billion Yuan, Setting STAR Market Record
item.description:
CXMT's chairman proposed increasing the share buyback cap from 2 billion yuan to 5 billion yuan, setting a new record for single-instance buybacks on the STAR Market. This move comes amid stock price pressure and following a turnaround to profitability in the first three quarters, aiming to boost investor confidence and stabilize market value.

item.title: Oracle Cancels $7B Tencent AI Chip Lease After US Objections
item.description:
Oracle has cancelled a $7 billion, five-year lease with Tencent after US objections, stripping access to up to 100K advanced AI chips via Southeast Asian data centers. This move, alongside Nvidia's new resale restrictions, cuts off a critical overseas compute channel for Chinese labs and leaves Tencent facing a training capacity gap just as its Hunyuan models compete with Alibaba's Qwen.

原文标题：Oracle 因美方反对取消腾讯 70 亿美元 AI 芯片租赁协议

Why it matters：地缘政治对 AI 算力供应链的直接干预案例，揭示了中美双重挤压下云厂商与模型公司的现实困境。

item.description:
Retail prices for the Nvidia RTX 5090 have surged past $9,000, significantly exceeding its launch price. This trend highlights a supply-demand imbalance in high-end AI compute hardware and rising overall GPU costs, creating substantial barriers for individual developers and small teams relying on local LLM inference.

item.title: China Issues Plan to Cut Energy Use in AI Data Centers
item.description:

The initiative aims to optimize energy structures and targets a \u003e10% reduction in industrial energy intensity by 2030, directly impacting the efficiency standards and green transition of AI compute facilities.

item.title: AI Ranked Last in Voter Priorities for 2026 U.S. Midterms
item.description:
NBC News exit polls reveal that AI and data center expansion ranked last among voter priorities in the 2026 U.S. midterm elections. Despite a recent surge in public interest, only 56% of respondents deemed the issue decisive or important for their vote, significantly trailing government corruption (90%) and cost of living (89%).

原文标题：2026 美国中期选举民调显示 AI 议题关注度垫底

Why it matters：提供了关于 AI 社会接受度与政治影响力的具体量化数据，有助于行业理解当前舆论环境。

item.title: Tsinghua Study Reveals Critical Failures in AI Agent Memory Deletion
item.description:
A new Tsinghua University paper reveals that AI agents with long-term memory fail to cleanly delete personal data upon user request. Testing across six memory systems showed an end-to-end success rate of less than 1.5%, with most deleted facts still extractable via simple prompts. The study urges developers to implement and verify actual deletion paths rather than relying on superficial confirmation messages.

原文标题：清华研究揭示 AI 智能体长期记忆删除机制严重失效

Why it matters：揭示了当前 AI 智能体在隐私合规与数据生命周期管理上的核心缺陷，对开发者具有极高的警示价值。

item.title: Hinton Warns AI Could Cause Major Incidents and Might Not Be Worth Developing
item.description:
Nobel laureate and AI pioneer Geoffrey Hinton states that within ten years, we will know if AI risks can be managed. He warns of potential major incidents like financial or power grid shutdowns soon, suggesting humanity might have been better off without developing AI, while still acknowledging its potential for a wonderful future.

原文标题：Hinton 警告：AI 或致重大事故，人类可能本不该开发它

Why it matters：顶级 AI 先驱对技术安全性的深刻反思与具体风险预警，具有极高的行业警示意义和话题热度。

item.title: Infineon Launches First RISC-V Automotive MCU Platform AURIX RC1
item.description:
Infineon has unveiled the AURIX RC1, its first automotive microcontroller platform based on the open-standard RISC-V architecture, with samples expected in H1 2027. The platform integrates an edge AI parallel processing unit and post-quantum cryptography support to simplify software-defined vehicle development through a unified, scalable hardware foundation, backed by the DRIVECORE ecosystem for accelerated migration.

item.title: Gemini Paid Users' Chat Data Used for Training Without Opt-Out
item.description:
Google Gemini personal subscription users' chat history is used for model training by default with no specific opt-out. To prevent this, users must disable 'Keep Activity,' which deletes chats after 72 hours. Additionally, some conversations are reviewed by humans and retained for up to three years, with Google explicitly warning against entering confidential information.

原文标题：Gemini 付费用户聊天数据仍用于训练且无法单独退出

Why it matters：揭示了主流 AI 产品隐私政策的重大漏洞，直接影响企业和个人用户对敏感数据的处理决策。

item.title: China Merchants Releases Lion-ER-35B-A3B Embodied Reasoning Model with Capability-Driven Data Engine
item.description:
The China Merchants Lion Mountain Lab released the open-source embodied reasoning VLM 'Lion-ER-35B-A3B'. Utilizing a MoE architecture (35B total, 3B active), it shifts from data accumulation to a 'capability-driven' data engine, decomposing tasks into 8 domains and 39 fine-grained capabilities for iterative optimization. The model achieves improvements across ten mainstream embodied benchmarks, surpassing larger models in key areas by enhancing robots' understanding of 3D space, object states, and task progress.

原文标题：招商局发布 Lion-ER-35B-A3B 具身推理模型 主打能力牵引数据引擎

Why it matters：提供了具身智能领域区别于传统数据堆砌的新范式（能力牵引数据引擎），且模型已开源并具备实际评测结果，对机器人开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Google Ties Search Access to Mandatory AI Features for Schools
item.description:
Starting early 2027, Google will issue an ultimatum to schools: accept AI features for students or lose access to Google Search entirely. Google's VP of Education claims search and AI are too fused to separate, sparking backlash from major districts like NYC and LA that previously restricted student AI use while seeking non-AI search options.

Why it matters：揭示了科技巨头通过基础设施垄断强制推行AI策略的商业与伦理争议，对教育界及依赖谷歌生态的用户有直接影响。

item.title: Unitree Founder Predicts Five Core Resources for Future AI Era
item.description:
Unitree Robotics founder Wang Xingxing stated at the 2026 World Internet Conference that data, computing power, chip production capacity, energy, and minerals will be the five most critical resources of the future. He also predicted next year as a potential tipping point for the robotics industry and outlined three strategic pillars: mass production scaling, physical AI small models, and ultra-large-scale computing clusters.

item.title: XPeng & Universities Release GroundingPI, Outperforming GPT-6 in Embodied Perception
item.description:
XPeng, Peking University, and HKU released GroundingPI, an embodied perception foundation model. Adopting a 'perception-first' approach trained on action-free data, it outperforms OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra across 34 benchmarks. The model aims to enhance robotic spatial grounding and reduce demonstration costs. Currently a research prototype, its code and weights are open-source.

原文标题：小鹏联合高校发布 GroundingPI，具身感知模型跑分超 GPT-6

Why it matters：展示了具身智能领域‘先感知后行动’的新范式，且在小参数规模下超越了前沿闭源模型的特定能力，具有较高技术参考价值。

item.title: AI 抢占产能致内存短缺延续至 2030 年
item.description:
受 AI 服务器芯片抢占成熟制程产能影响，行业预计全球内存短缺将持续至 2029-2030 年。手机厂商反映 BOM 采购成本持续走高，且连带 OLED IC 出现缺货涨价现象。尽管渠道端因资金压力出现局部降价出货，但上游 DRAM 大厂 2027 年产能已售罄，长期供应紧张格局难改。

Why it matters：揭示了 AI 算力扩张对消费电子供应链造成的结构性挤压与长期价格影响。

item.title: Osewa 发布：面向 AI Agent 的开源终端协议
item.description:
Osewa 是一款专为长时运行 AI Agent 设计的开源终端连接工具，旨在替代 SSH 和 Mosh。它利用 QUIC/TCP 协议实现会话持久化与网络漫游，在弱网环境下按键响应速度比 SSH 快 8-100 倍，允许开发者从任意设备无缝接入后台运行的 Agent 任务。

Why it matters：解决了 AI Agent 长时间运行时的远程交互痛点，具备显著的性能优势与场景针对性。

item.description:

item.description:
